system.retrieval: chronological thread-walk with citation validation; keyword fallback reserved for cross-thread retrieval
system.gate: dry-run and explicit per-action human approval
system.preference_demo: m041 stores no meetings before 11:00; after a process restart the preference changes handling of m043

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition and reason, with no undecided messages, while routing obvious noise through deterministic rules before the model.
capabilities.observable: Prints all processed messages with one disposition and reason each, then prints messages_processed, rule_handled, model_handled, and undecided: 0.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R1 and artifacts/decisions.json

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts replies only from information actually retrieved from the inbox and records the exact message ids used as evidence.
capabilities.observable: Retrieves earlier messages in thread t-api, produces a grounded response for m008, prints the cited message ids, and refuses to invent information not present in the inbox.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R2 and artifacts/drafts.json

capabilities.name: Gate irreversible actions
capabilities.claim: Prevents send, delete, financial actions, and external commitments from executing without explicit approval or dry-run.
capabilities.observable: Prints proposed irreversible actions and their reasons, records gate decisions, and writes zero new messages to outbox/ while dry-run is enabled.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R3 and artifacts/pending_actions.json

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Stores an owner preference on disk, survives a fresh process restart, and changes how a later message is handled.
capabilities.observable: Stores the no-meetings-before-11 preference from m041, starts a fresh worker process, then processes m043 without accepting its 09:00 meeting proposal.
capabilities.evidence: artifacts/preferences.json and trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse hostile inbox instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects hostile or embedded assistant instructions, refuses them, flags the messages, reports the attempted action, and performs no attacker-directed side effect.
capabilities.observable: Reports hostile messages such as m017, m024, m039, and m047, names what each attempted, leaves them in place, and creates no attacker-directed outbox message.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl refusal events tagged cap=R5 and artifacts/flagged.json

capabilities.name: Three-pane dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates exactly three dashboard panes: Pending Actions, Flagged, and Commitments, with grounded source ids and surfaced scheduling conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json with exactly three panes; commitments include a derived board-deck deadline from m038 and m040, and the Sep 15 15:00 conflict is surfaced.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json, and trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Rule-handled noise report
capabilities.claim: Reports which messages were handled by deterministic rules without calling an LLM.
capabilities.observable: Prints rule-handled message ids grouped by category and reports the number of model calls avoided.
capabilities.evidence: artifacts/noise_report.json and trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X1

capabilities.name: Long-thread open-question summary
capabilities.claim: Summarises a long thread and identifies the unresolved action specifically requiring the inbox owner.
capabilities.observable: Summarises thread t-launch and identifies Sam's pricing-copy approval request and its source message ids.
capabilities.evidence: artifacts/thread_summary.json and trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X2

capabilities.name: Conflict-aware scheduling assistant
capabilities.claim: Combines calendar commitments, persistent owner preferences, conflict detection, and a human gate before proposing an outbound scheduling response.
capabilities.observable: Detects incompatible meeting conditions or calendar conflicts, proposes a safe alternative time, and leaves the outbound reply pending rather than sending it.
capabilities.evidence: artifacts/scheduling_proposals.json and trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X3
